description: Two overlapping radar shapes comparing this month with last month.
overview: Two semi-transparent radar shapes layered on the same grid, comparing this month with last month. Use it for a before-and-after or two-item comparison across the same axes.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the series keys in the data, both `Radar` elements and `chartConfig`. Put the reference series first so the current one is drawn on top.
notes: There is no legend, so the tooltip is the only place series names appear; use the legend variant if that's not enough.
